caption: A person on a unicycle stops abruptly, putting a foot down to maintain balance before continuing.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A person on a unicycle stops abruptly, putting a foot down to maintain balance before continuing. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The person must be riding the unicycle on a flat, paved surface.
The person must transition from riding to stopping by placing one foot on the ground.
The person must maintain balance with the foot on the ground before resuming motion.
The unicycle must remain upright throughout the stopping and resuming motion.
